entities.name: Achaemenid Persian Empire
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Achaemenid Persian Empire, a political institution in Oman during Ancient Magan and Bronze Age Trade (1300 BCE–300 BCE). Grew from Magan Copper and Mesopotamian Trade and Umm an-Nar culture flourishes with extensive copper smelting and Gulf trade. Led to the emergence of Iron Age and Falaj Irrigation.
